item.text:
1. **Food Safety and Growth Initiative, Intake 2.** Eligible Ontario agri-food businesses with fewer than 100 employees at the project location can receive up to **$75,000 per project** for food safety equipment, traceability systems, and related improvements. The announced intake runs through **March 1, 2027**, or until funding is fully committed. [Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada announcement](https://www.canada.ca/en/agriculture-agri-food/news/2026/10/canada-and-ontario-investing-2-million-to-protect-the-provinces-agri-food-industry.html)
2. **Supply Management Processing Investment Fund.** This federal fund prioritizes small and medium-sized businesses and offers non-repayable contributions to eligible dairy, poultry, and egg processors buying new automated equipment, such as production lines or packaging machinery. The guide says applications are accepted until funds are fully allocated. The program ends **March 31, 2028**. [Federal applicant guide](https://agriculture.canada.ca/en/programs/supply-management-processing-investment-fund/applicant-guide)
3. **Meat Processors Capacity Improvement Initiative.** This Ontario cost-share program funded equipment purchases for meat processors and abattoirs, including cutters, packaging machines, and vacuum sealers. The intake described on this page closed **September 25, 2023**. [Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada award announcement](https://www.canada.ca/en/agriculture-agri-food/news/2024/02/governments-helping-food-processors-boost-efficiency.html)
